definitions.cash_investment: One row. capital_cash is the authored metric cash paid for PPE plus finance-lease principal, excluding interest. noncash_lease_additions are ROU assets obtained for lease obligations, separately reported and outside capital_cash.
definitions.ppe_bridge: One row, all USD million. purchase_proxy is cash PPE payments adjusted for the change in disclosed PPE purchase payables. It is a displayed-value analytical proxy, not a claim of fully identified accounting additions. lease_additions are noncash finance-lease additions. Use the Note 6 PPE depreciation scope, including finance-lease asset amortization, as the bridge convention. explained_change is the net PPE movement attributable to the supplied recognition and consumption disclosures on the specified scope. residual is observed net PPE increase less explained_change. Rounded billion-dollar disclosures remain approximate economic observations even though point arithmetic is graded precisely.
definitions.lease_movements: Three rows keyed gross, accumulated and net. Accumulated depreciation is a positive contra-asset magnitude. change is ending less beginning balance. explained_change is the corresponding movement accounted for by disclosed new finance-lease ROU recognition and finance-lease asset amortization. residual is observed less explained.

claim_assertions.claim_1: FY2025 finance-lease principal cash payments equal the disclosed FY2025 noncash finance-lease ROU additions.
claim_assertions.claim_2: The increase in net finance-lease PPE exceeds FY2025 finance-lease principal cash payments.
claim_assertions.claim_3: Acquired PPE accounts for the entire total-PPE net bridge residual.

numeric_policy: Displayed-value arithmetic. Absolute tolerances are computational, not claims of source precision.
